R3B-bear-backcountry-0004.name: By Manteau Creek
R3B-bear-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2014 (12 years old), 200 m SE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
SE facing slope, 17 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Manteau Creek 60 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Blue River, about 55 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, North Thompson FSR, Manteau-Canvas Creek FSR, Manteau.
Park: 52.48365, -119.40778, pull off on Manteau (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.3 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 537 m, about 180 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 410 m S of the spot at 1,284 m (52.44295, -119.48029). Water: Manteau Creek 170 m NW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-44, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R3B-bear-backcountry-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-44: about 45 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
